en.ammaar-muslim: [6/1571] al-Kafi: Ali b. Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad b. Uthman who said:

I recited in the presence of Abi Abdillah عليه السلام “Dhawa Adlin minkum -> two just men among you” [5:95]. So he said (it should be): “Dhu Adlin Minkum -> a just man among you”. This is among that which the scribes made a mistake in
